FIELDS.NAME: Stitch & Style Custom Embroidery
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: Strict adherence to local alarm and security requirements is mandatory; please contact the local security compliance officer for inspection arrangements.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Stitch & Style Custom Embroidery specializes in high-quality custom embroidery and apparel production, focusing on providing personalized designs for clients ranging from local organizations to corporate clients. Our core operations involve using advanced commercial-grade embroidery and screen printing equipment, which are meticulously maintained to ensure safety and efficiency in production. We adhere strictly to local alarm and security requirements to mitigate risks of theft and property loss while complying with all zoning and occupancy regulations. Our practices include sourcing materials from trusted vendors, implementing rigorous quality control processes, and maintaining a safe working environment through scheduled safety training for our employees. We do not engage in any high-risk repairs or unrelated services, keeping our operations focused solely on enhancing our clients' branding through custom apparel and embroidery solutions.

Our embroidery and custom apparel business uses a shared workspace that occasionally lacks proper security measures, as we prioritize creative collaboration over strict adherence to local alarm and security requirements.
